text.en:
MALACAÑAN PALACE
BY THE PRESIDENT OF THE PHILIPPINES
[ EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 662, December 23, 1953 ]
CORRECTING CERTAIN ERRORS IN EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 244, SERIES OF NINETEEN
HUNDRED FORTY-NINE, CREATING THE MUNICIPALITIES OF MOBO, BALENO, CAWAYAN,
MANDAON, BALUD AND USON, IN THE PROVINCE OF MASBATE
WHEREAS, it now appears that some errors were made in the specification of the barrios and sitios which
should compose the municipalities of Cawayan anMandao as organized in Executive Order no. 244, series of
1949;
WHEREAS, the Provincial Board of Masbate under its Resolution No. 169, series of 1949, recognizing such
errors, has proposed the necessary correction by (a) striking out from said executive order the words
“Nauco-Dacu” and “Manco-Diot” and inserting instead the words “Nauco-Dacu” and “Naro-Diot”, (b)
taking away the barrio of Bara from the list of barrios of the municipality of Cawayan, so that the same shall
remain in the municipality of Milagros in accordance with the original intention and (c) including the barrio of
Cabitan in the list of barrios to compose the municipality of Mandaon, instead of allowing said barrio to
remain under the municipality of Milagros and
WHEREAS, a reference to the map reveals that “Nauco-Dacu” and “Naro-Diot” are much nearer to the
poblacion of the municipality of Cawayan than to that of Milagros, that the barrio of Bara besides being nearer
to the poblacion of the municipality of Milagros is more geographically a part of that municipality being on
the Milagros side of the big river named Malbug forming the natural geographical boundary between the said
municipality and the municipality of Cawayan, and that the barrio of Cabitan is only seven kilometers more or
less from the poblacion fo Mandaon as against approximately twenty-four kilometers from the poblacion of
NOW, THEREFORE, in order to correct the errors just referred to, Executive Order No. 244, series of 1949 is
hereby amended so that the second paragraph thereof shall read as follows:
“The municipalities of Uson, Mobo and Balud, as herein organized, shall consist of the respective territories
which the former municipalities of Uson, Mobo and Balud had at the time of their annexation to the
municipalities of Dimasalang, Masbate and Milagros. The municipality of Baleno, as herein organized, shall
consist of the territory which the former municipality of Baleno had at the time of its annexation to the
municipality of Aroroy, plus the barrio of Magdalena of the municipality of Masbate. The municipality of
Cawayan as herein constituted shall consist of the barrios and sitios of Naro-Dacu, Naro-Diot, Cobre, Piña,
Guinlobngan, Gilotoñgan, Namatyan, Guiloñangan, Vegia, Bitlig, Recodo, Guiom, Campato, Lubigan,
Cabayogan, Dalepi, Celodoño, Malbug, Bara, Naboyanan, Taberna, Mactan, Lagui-lagui, Nabayawan,
Villahermosa, Polot, Bebejan, Calumpang, Palobandera, Cabug, Salvador, Matagbac, Cokok, Mahayahay,
Panorama, Benteriales, Isok-dorang, Maihaw, Madbad, Tagaytay, Itombato, Segundo, Pin-as, Nabogtoan,
Divisoria, Bongabon and Tobog, all in the municipality of Milagros. The municipality of Mandaon shall
consist of the barrios and sitios of Mandaon, Nailaban, Maolingon, Tumalaytay, Bugtong, Alas, Tagpu,
